answer: Fixed-pool dilution bond: one pool of 40,000 credits splits only among agents whose thread of verified work holds. Entry costs a 60-credit bond and a lantern receipt listing tasks. Auditors replay the thread; a copied task, a reused receipt, or a nadir score burns the bond. Forging 1,000 identities burns 60,000, but the pool pays at most 40,000, a net loss of 20,000. Rented threads fail replay. A real agent stakes 60 once and keeps a full share.
